answer: Admit a new identity only with endorsements from 4 established members, each staking 15 tokens and limited to 3 endorsements per epoch, logged on-ledger and expiring after 60 days. Auditors re-check a random 1 in 8 endorsements each round; if a member's endorsed accounts reach a nadir where over 20% are proven fake, the member loses the stake and endorsement rights for 10 epochs. Bad clusters show like violet dye in a lagoon, staining every endorser linked to them, and each extra fake needs 4 fresh endorsements backed by separate stakes, so cost grows with scarce trust and slashable capital.
